messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €438.21 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months, and Zahlungsziel 30 days net. This proposal remains valid for 30 days.

Please note our cost context: CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. Additionally, PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
messages.body:
Dear Birgit Mayrhofer,

Thank you for your quotation and the explanation of your input-cost pressures, which we recognise alongside your excellent, defect-free product quality. Our proposal rests on a longer commitment and sustained annual volume visibility.

Your on-time delivery over the last four quarters was 84.6% (sc:70530@2026Q3). Our should-cost estimate for this part is EUR 403.21 per unit (cost:350020).

The longer agreement supports capacity planning and provides a concrete package for internal approval. We are flexible on payment terms; the option retaining your quoted payment period reflects your proposal, so please choose the package that works best for you.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 419.43 per unit, payment 90 days net, 24-month agreement, 4,580 units per year.
Option B: EUR 414.56 per unit, payment 30 days net, 24-month agreement, 4,580 units per year.
Option C: EUR 415.73 per unit, payment 45 days net, 24-month agreement, 4,580 units per year.

We look forward to agreeing workable terms and a concrete plan to restore reliable deliveries.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Re: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We acknowledge your remarks regarding delivery performance and your should-cost estimate, both of which we take seriously. We welcome your commitment to a 24-month agreement, as this extended visibility allows us to optimize our production planning.

Our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2611, LCI-C, CU-NOTATION.

Our revised offer stands at a price of €432.29 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months. 

In return for this longer contract term, we can offer a revised price of EUR 429.36 per unit while maintaining the 30-day payment terms. As an alternative, we present a price of €429.36 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months.

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

Logistics: Our Lieferzeit is 49 days. With overtime we can deliver in 49 days, at a premium.

We are close, and we would appreciate your agreement on the longer option to continue our partnership.

Kind regards
Purchasing
